figures.title: Cylinder and optical markers
figures.interpretation: The optical cameras follow two reflective markers on the transported cylinder.

figures.title: Seated transport setup
figures.interpretation: The seated participant moves the cylinder across the marked tabletop.

figures.title: Physical target arrangement
figures.interpretation: Nine target centres sit on the 250-mm-radius semicircle, 1 on the participant's left and 9 on the participant's right.

figures.title: Camera world frame
figures.interpretation: The lab's Vicon system reconstructs 3-D optical positions; its calibration origin is at the starting circle.

figures.title: Visual cue and acoustic signal
figures.interpretation: The published schematic gives a target-display period of 1.5 s, variable wait of 1–2 s, reaching interval of 3.5 s and return interval of 3 s.
